name: Garden Cleaner Evolution
desc:
Collect leaves, clean the garden, uncover secrets, and become the ultimate Leaf Sweeper! 🍂✨

🧹 Sweep away piles of leaves and restore messy gardens to their former glory
🎁 Unlock exciting rewards as you clean and progress through new areas
🔍 Discover hidden secrets and mysterious surprises scattered throughout the gardens
🛠️ Upgrade your tools to sweep faster, collect more leaves, and become more powerful
🔄 Rebirth to reset your progress, gain powerful bonuses, and push your Leaf Sweeper skills even further
🏆 Become a Legendary Leaf Sweeper and prove you’re the best cleaner in the garden!
🎯 Complete quests to unlock exclusive titles and show off your achievements to your friends!
🧘‍♂️ The ultimate ASMR relaxation game: no stress, just cozy garden cleaning.

Developed by: SailentTC
